title: Contact external correlation and bounded penalty governance

scope.external_comparator: Code_Aster unilateral exact constraint; CalculiX elastic pre-contact tie-breaker

requirements.name: Unilateral normal operator external correlation
requirements.evidence: Code_Aster LIAISON_UNIL compression/opening and an active planar TET4 face comparison.
requirements.policy: Compare the declared displacement, gap and active-branch observables using the existing predeclared adapter limits.

requirements.name: Bounded structural contact-path correlation
requirements.evidence: Code_Aster ten-point curves for two unilateral stop probes and a deformable TET4 two-slave model.
requirements.policy: Report complete displacement and gap curves; keep transition differences explicit when exact unilateral and penalty formulations are not identical.

requirements.name: Independent CalculiX tie-breaker
requirements.evidence: CalculiX 2.20 C3D4 pre-contact displacement probe on the same refined TET4 structural mesh.
requirements.policy: Use only as an elastic pre-contact comparison; it is not a contact-law or active-set qualification.

requirements.name: Bounded penalty governance
requirements.evidence: Lot 1 and Lot 2 sweeps over 1e4, 1e5 and 1e6 at three TET4 mesh levels.
requirements.policy: Candidate interval is limited to the tested TET4 initial-search benchmark. No universal production interval or conditioning cutoff is inferred.

requirements.name: Lot aggregation and limitation traceability
requirements.evidence: Lot 1, Lot 2 and Lot 3 manifests with source SHA, dirty state, commands, tool images and digests.
requirements.policy: A bounded external result cannot promote finite sliding, surface-to-surface contact, friction or a general penalty policy.

predeclared_adapter_policies.source: Existing Code_Aster/CalculiX verification adapters at the qualified source SHA; no new threshold selected after observation.

penalty_policy.scope: TET4 initial-search node-to-triangle penalty benchmark at the Lot 2 mesh levels

out_of_scope: contact tangent qualification across active-set discontinuities
universal penalty selection or conditioning cutoff
official gate closure without Owner decision
